1.title: Andrew Tate exaggerates and did not own supercars in photos, his lawyers say
1.summary: Prosecutors argue Tate and his brother Tristan are a flight risk and should not be released on bail.

2.title: She Was Absolved of a Heinous Crime. Why Won’t They Leave Her Alone?
2.summary: A judge exonerated Nancy Smith, an Ohio bus driver, after she was convicted of abusing children in her care. Now, prosecutors want to reverse an order saying she was innocent.

3.title: Many N.F.L. Players Get Brain Disease. Why Hasn’t OSHA Intervened?
3.summary: “We never see things that are this dire,” a former chief scientist of the agency said about rates of C.T.E. in former players.

4.title: Two unvaccinated people die of measles in Pennsylvania
4.summary: Cases in the US have hit the highest point since the virus was eliminated, as vaccination rates decline.

5.title: Tornado Rips Through Towns in Southern France
5.summary: An uncommonly powerful tornado destroyed dozens of homes and knocked out power to about 2,800 households.

6.title: Christian Convert Who Fled Iran and Was Deported By Trump Finds New Home
6.summary: Artemis Ghasemzadeh, who had escaped religious persecution, was deported to Panama under Trump’s immigration crackdown. Now, Canada has given her asylum.
